item.title: [ransomware] Less Lucrative Ransomware Market Makes Attackers Alter Methods
item.description: Ransomware actors are ditching Cobalt Strike in favor of native Windows tools, as payment rates hit record lows and data theft surges.

item.title: [ransomware] Ransomware Attacks are on the Rise
item.description: Lockbit is by far this summer’s most prolific ransomware group, trailed by two offshoots of the Conti group.
